# HexPiece 2.6.4

The first-person sword with Haki on. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks pass.

- **No more lag or flashing with Haki on and a sword in hand.** In first person, the sword view drew your arms through the
  original's Haki arm code, which was failing every frame. With Haki on, your arms are now the game's own hands. Your skin is
  already blackened by Haki, so they still look coated.
- **The coated blade keeps its temper.** It now turns a very dark purple instead of flat black, so the bright temper line still
  shows through, deep purple on near black. The black still creeps up from the guard as before.
